scope.default: Accept every valid request authority for port-forwarded browser access without a host allowlist.
scope.boundary: Preserve same-origin checks, cross-site rejection, launch-token and signed-cookie authentication, protocol and authority scoped cookies, and all request admission and RPC behavior. Treat this deployment as remotely reachable for directory selection.
limitations: The listener remains loopback; external reachability is provided by the forwarding or proxy layer.
Requests with an invalid Host, a mismatched Origin or a cross-site marker remain rejected.
